submit_multinode_training_job: submit a multinode training job to a SLURM cluster using submitit with GPU and node configuration
run_trainer_call: run the Trainer callable to set up GPU args and start training via training.main
checkpoint_trainer_requeue: checkpoint the Trainer and requeue a DelayedSubmission to resume training from the latest epoch checkpoint
